issues.legal_issue: A court deciding the allocation of land-acquisition compensation cannot distribute shares contrary to a valid probate that remains unrevoked.
material_facts: A competent civil court granted probate of a will that allocated two-thirds of the relevant interest to one group and one-third to another.
The probate had not been revoked in appropriate proceedings.
After land was acquired, the reference court and the High Court directed that the compensation be divided equally, rather than according to the shares in the will.
issues.conclusion: The lower courts were wrong to direct equal payment because the unrevoked probate bound the parties and specified different shares. The appeal was allowed, without preventing the party disputing the probate from pursuing an appropriate proceeding to challenge it.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 275 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925, a probate granted by a competent civil court is conclusive and binds the parties until duly revoked in appropriate proceedings. A court deciding a dispute over the division of land-acquisition compensation cannot disregard the shares specified in an unrevoked probate. The Court rejected the contention that Sections 18, 30, or 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, permitted a different allocation in these circumstances. No earlier cases were relied on.

rule.if: land_acquisition_compensation_allocation_proceeding and probate_granted_by_competent_court and probate_unrevoked and probate_specifies_shares

predicates.land_acquisition_compensation_allocation: The proceeding concerns allocation of compensation for acquired land.
predicates.probate_granted_by_competent_court: A competent court granted probate of a will affecting the parties' interests.
predicates.probate_unrevoked: No appropriate proceeding had revoked the probate.
predicates.probate_specifies_shares: The probated will specifies the shares of the interested parties.
predicates.compensation_shares_follow_probate: The compensation is allocated according to the shares specified in the unrevoked probate.

issues.definition: When a compensation-allocation proceeding involves a competent court's unrevoked probate specifying shares, the compensation shares follow that probate.
